3. Exemption is granted subject to all just legal exceptions. 2,4&5. It is submitted that though the electric meter installed at the subject premises was replaced by the SEPCO as far back as 1998, the petitioner continues to receive detection bills from SEPCO in respect of the electric meter that had been removed despite the fact that he had settled all such arrears.

The petitioner’s dispute with the SEPCO seems to fall squarely within sub-section (4) of section 26 of the Electricity Act, 1910, which provides that such disputes shall be referred to the Electric Inspector. Therefore, the petition is dismissed in limine while referring the petitioner to the Electric Inspector.
